Hero.sub: 7 years turning product requirements into accessible, production-ready React & Next.js interfaces — with a focus on performance, design systems, and the details most people skip.

About.sub: I'm Florencia, a Frontend Engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable web applications with React, TypeScript, and Next.js — most recently on CookUnity's Growth team, owning the acquisition funnel end-to-end..
About.secondSub: I specialize in translating product and design requirements into polished, production-ready interfaces: reusable components, responsive layouts, and accessible experiences that hold up under real traffic, not just in Figma.
About.thirdSub: I care about the parts that are easy to skip — semantic markup, keyboard navigation, Core Web Vitals — because that's what separates an interface that looks done from one that actually works for everyone.
About.lastSub: Outside of client work, I build small tools to keep my fundamentals sharp: component libraries, headless CMS integrations, and the odd side project that has no deadline but me.
